severityRule: Any cross-request leakage is P0 or P1 depending on exposed content.

cases.desc: two interleaved requests, different conversations, both persist

assert: each response carries its own outcome
no-attempt response must not inherit PERSISTED
timeout response must not report PERSISTED

cases.desc: domain-boundary response interleaved with ordinary answer
assert: boundary receipt does not leak into ordinary answer

cases.desc: clarification interleaved with safe calendar replacement

assert: error response declares its own truthful status
every response matches its own turn
no cross-request leakage of any kind

cases.desc: multiple internal persistence calls within one request
assert: public receipt corresponds to the correct final response turn
